test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘STRAIGHT’ is written as ‘UVTCUIHJ’, ‘SURVIVAL’ is written as ‘UWTXMBWJ’. How will ‘TAKEOVER’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First four letters → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Last four letters → (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

So,

 
• ‘STRAIGHT’ is written as ‘UVTCUIHJ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5995c7bbab7544a12fceddf464b6f678280fb1110fec5e9d9751d9dad6857cb4.png] 

And,

 
• ‘SURVIVAL’ is written as ‘UWTXMBWJ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eb4483e0700a905a400916293116498c7cfbd3326ec87174072feeefa1f15cc.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘TAKEOVER’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f2489d1ca070c58cbd34bec109aa5598b5399250097afe42ece75c6da61744f.png] 

​Hence, "**VCMGSFWP**" is the correct answer.

3d
